Meta.description: On-chain K-pop photocard vault and marketplace: cards vaulted in Seoul, ownership as Solana NFTs, settled in USDT, redeemable anytime.
Meta.vaultDescription: Every vaulted photocard with its Solana NFT, holder and status, publicly verifiable.
Meta.packsDescription: Open a pack and pull an authenticated, vaulted K-pop photocard. Finite pools, live odds, on-chain randomness.
Meta.catalogDescription: Every official K-pop photocard by group, album and version. Mark what you have and what you want.
Meta.binderDescription: Your K-pop photocard collection, organized like a real binder. Mint the cards you own.
Meta.chartsDescription: Weekly K-pop album sales and first-week rankings.

Hero.body: Send your cards to Idolca. Once authenticated, each one gets its own NFT on Solana. When it sells, the card stays in the vault while the NFT and USDT swap in a single transaction, so no more mailing cards back and forth or worrying about fakes. Want to hold it? Burn the NFT and we ship it anywhere.
Hero.hint: Drag to rotate and see the back

How.title: Cards stay in the vault, trading happens on-chain
How.subtitle: No more unshipped orders, fakes or cross-border postage. Every card has a unique serial and its full history is public on-chain.
How.s1Body: Mail your cards to our Seoul vault, or open albums online and have your pulls vaulted directly.
How.s2Body: Each card is authenticated and scanned front and back, then minted as its own NFT on Solana.
How.s3Body: The card never moves. An escrow program swaps the NFT and USDT in one transaction, and you can also trade on Magic Eden or Tensor.
How.s4Body: Request redemption and the NFT is frozen, then burned when the card ships. Combine several cards into one worldwide shipment.

Vault.intro: Every card in the vault maps to one Metaplex Core NFT. The number of unburned NFTs always equals the number of physical cards: NFTs of cards being redeemed are frozen, and burned when the card ships.
Vault.demo: Demo data. Set HELIUS_API_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_CARD_COLLECTION to read the on-chain collection.
Vault.search: Search serial, card, NFT address or holder

Packs.title: Mystery Pack
Packs.subtitle: Open a pack and pull an authenticated photocard straight into your vault. Every pool is finite, odds are live, and every pull is verifiable on-chain.
Packs.chance: {price} USDT for a chance at {top} USDT
Packs.how1Body: Each pack has a fixed pool of vaulted cards. Odds are published and update as the pool sells.
Packs.how2Body: Open 1, 5 or 10 at a time and flip each card. Randomness comes from Switchboard VRF.
Packs.how3Body: Pulls land in your wallet as NFTs. Keep them in the vault, list them, sell them back instantly, or redeem the card.
Packs.demoNote: Demo mode: pulls are simulated in your browser and no USDT is charged. Real pulls open when the pack program goes live.
Packs.expectedBody: {rtp}% of the price at the current pool. It changes as cards are pulled.
Packs.oddsSubtitle: Each tier's share of the cards still in the pool.

Packs.noPulls: No pulls yet. Be the first when the pack opens.
Packs.fairCommit: Before sales open, the full pool list is hashed and committed on Solana, so it can't be changed afterwards.
Packs.fairVrf: Every pull takes its randomness from Switchboard VRF, recorded in the same transaction as the mint.
Packs.fairNft: Pulled cards are minted to your wallet as NFTs and stay in the Seoul vault until you redeem them.
Packs.rule18: 18+ only, and unavailable in some regions.
Packs.ruleBuyback: Instant buyback pays {pct}% of a card's market value in USDT.

Mint.title: Mint a card you own
Mint.subtitle: Photograph the front and back, then name it. It doesn't need to be in our catalog.
Mint.choosePhoto: Take or upload a photo of the front
Mint.freeMintNote: Anyone can mint any card. It's labeled Self-reported until our vault authenticates it. If the vault finds it's fake, the NFT is permanently labeled Fake.
Mint.demoNote: Demo mode: no NFT is written on-chain yet. The photo and record are saved to your account.
Mint.done: Minted. You'll find it at the front of your binder.
Mint.statusBody_self_reported: Minted by its owner and not checked by Idolca yet. Send the card to our vault to have it authenticated.
Mint.statusBody_authentic: Authenticated in person by the Idolca vault.
Mint.statusBody_fake: Our vault found this card is not genuine. The label is permanent and shown wherever the NFT appears.

Charts.title: Album sales chart
Charts.subtitle: Weekly K-pop album sales and first-week rankings, following how Hanteo and Circle count.
Charts.method_hanteo_body: Counts retail sales to fans in real time: a sale is recorded when an affiliated store scans and ships the album. First-week ("chodong") sales are the first 7 days.
Charts.method_circle_body: Counts albums shipped by distributors to stores, published weekly and monthly. Returns are deducted later, so numbers can be revised.
Charts.method_idolca_body: Planned: pre-order an album here, we buy it from an affiliated store and unbox it in Seoul. Your photocards go straight to the vault and the album counts toward the chart.
